name: Kong Godzilla Doge
look: Two stacked panels from Godzilla vs. Kong poster art. Top: Godzilla and King Kong brawl on a burning aircraft carrier at sea. Bottom: the two monsters stand together facing right as a small, edited-in Shiba Inu, Cheems, raises a baseball bat over his head to attack.
use: Two rivals fight each other in the top panel. In the bottom they face a small but determined third party, Cheems with a bat, who is ready to take on both of them.
slots: the third party swinging at both (Cheems, bottom)
describe: godzilla and king kong fighting then a shiba dog with a bat
two giant monsters brawling and a small dog ready to swing a baseball bat
monster fight on an aircraft carrier with a doge joining in
little shiba inu with a bat taking on both monsters
monster battle meme where a dog shows up to fight both
origin: Promotional art for Godzilla vs. Kong (2021), edited so that Cheems the Shiba Inu joins the fight with a baseball bat.
